sources.title: Google Search Central: creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
sources.scope: Editorial self-assessment and who/how/why guidance; no endorsement, ranking promise or universal quality score.

sources.title: W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
sources.scope: Technical accessibility and equivalent information; legal applicability and actual conformance need their own evidence.

sources.title: Hygiene people-first publication requirements
sources.scope: Local provenance/review/freshness/archive controls are explicit proposed organization policy, not universal Google mandates. SHA-256 identifies the issue body as UTF-8; external guidance hashes identify retrieved page bytes.

review_boundary: Mechanical evidence admission is separate from actual source truth, usefulness and independently verified human/editorial review. No search metric or universal score can supply that review.
